definition: Versioned definition with declared scope and interpretation.
seed: Versioned mathematical or physical starting input, including its type, origin and assumptions.
claim: Statement with an explicit evidence status.
assumption: Explicit premise requiring separate justification or declared adoption.
proof: Proof text with links to the precise statement and premise versions.
explanation: Expository text associated with registered objects.
transition: Connecting text with source, target and usage conditions.
latex-resource: Macro, package, figure, bibliography or other export dependency.
